overall_goal: Combine and mix melted butter and sugar in a large bowl

goals.description: Prepare the bowl and retrieve sugar
goals.rationale: The person sets up the mixing bowl on the scale and gathers packets of sugar from the cupboard.

goals.description: Pour the sugar into the bowl
goals.rationale: The person opens the sugar packets and empties their contents into the mixing bowl.

goals.description: Add the melted butter to the bowl
goals.rationale: The person moves the bowl off the scale and pours in the melted butter, scraping the jug to get it all out.

goals.description: Mix the butter and sugar together
goals.rationale: The person uses a fork to thoroughly stir and combine the sugar and melted butter in the bowl.
